name: wikinews-token-plugin
description: Connect the Wikinews MCP with a credential instead of a sign-in, plus the wikinews-research skill. A Miso product demo of credential-based install.

credential.title: Wikinews MCP credential
credential.description: The token you were given for the Wikinews MCP (it starts with miso-mcp-). Stored in your system's credential store, never in this plugin.
